item.title: github: Search and filter for budgets now available
item.description:
GitHub Billing’s “Budgets and alerts” page now lists all budgets in one place and adds search and filter capabilities. This makes it easier to find specific budgets in accounts with multiple entries.

  • Source: GitHub
